  • Plataforma interna repleta de cursos e treinamentos que impulsionam sua trajetória profissional;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo, perfeito para ensinar, aprender e se desenvolver tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente.

Nosso impacto vai além:

Cada dia na Americanas é uma oportunidade de transformar desafios em soluções; ideias em realizações. Estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença, cuidando das nossas pessoas e contribuindo para um impacto positivo não só para os nossos stakeholders, mas para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a autenticidade, a inovação e o trabalho coletivo, venha fazer parte da Americanas S.A. Aqui, crescemos juntos, resolvemos a vida de milhões e criamos histórias que inspiram.

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Fan Services Manager is responsible for delivering a world‑class fan experience at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The Fan Services Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.

This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.

  • Manage staff and volunteer requirements for Fan Services central and in each stadium.
  • Support procurement processes by defining operational and technical requirements for fan services at each stadium.
  • Contribute to budget planning, track delivery, and support post‑event reporting and debriefing.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks related to fan services across all venues.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).

  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering Fan Services at international sporting events.

  • Strong knowledge crowd management particularly within sporting events.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies.
  • Demonstrated excellence in customer service delivery.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams without formal reporting lines.
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large‑scale events.
  • Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.
  • Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic and evolving environments.
  • Strong IT proficiency, including MS Office and Visio.

Skills & Competencies

title: Prospect Research Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Developing a robust culture of prospect research and portfolio management is vital to the University’s fundraising and to Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) efforts to build sustainable and broad‑based annual, leadership, major, principal, and planned gift programs, as well as corporate and foundation relations prospect pipelines in support of annual and long‑term fundraising targets. The position embodies a customer‑service orientation to lead generation, potential prospect identification, research, and qualification and provides—both proactively and in response to requests from colleagues—confidential and thoroughly researched profiles, reports, and briefings tailored to the needs of a variety of audiences.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Research Analyst provides analysis and actionable support to gift officers and portfolio managers to inform prospect strategies and list segmentation. This position also works closely with the Advancement Services team and participates in regular prospect strategy meetings, ensuring quick and accurate updates of portfolios and donor records.

In collaboration with partners across campus, additional prospect names and introductions will be captured and centralized in DAR’s database. Teamwork and collaboration across campus and within DAR are essential.

Principal Accountabilities

  • This role identifies, tracks, segments, and analyzes donor records and key relationships between the existing Howard community and prospective new sources of support to meet annual and long‑term University fundraising objectives.
  • The role ensures prospect data is collected and input into Raiser’s Edge, requiring systematized efforts to review local and national news, business publications, economic trends, and business developments to keep abreast of prospect information and to provide relevant updates to gift officers on assigned prospects.
  • Core responsibilities include the timely creation of prospect briefings and reports using research and screening tools.
  • The position is expected to leverage analytics informed by predictive modelling, wealth screening, data mining and benchmarking to inform portfolio audit/balancing efforts and maintain a system of assigning prospects to gift officer portfolios.
  • The Prospect Research Analyst must keep current on research and fundraising trends through regular contact with industry resources as well as vendors.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrate sound project management skills;
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to analyze substantial amounts of data;
  • Ability to embody a customer service approach while providing support to multiple team members;
  • Ability to prepare tailored profile reports as needed/requested by gift officers and DAR leadership;
  • Knowledge of research software (i.e., Donor Search, WealthEngine, iWave, etc). and other tools;
  • Demonstrated proficiency in query and report building in a development CRM (Customer Relationship Management) (i.e. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce or similar)
  • Commitment to maintaining the professional and ethical standards set forth for the field by the Association of Researchers for Advancement (APRA);
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem‑solve and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence;
  • Ability to and adhere to standard operating procedures for data process functions;
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Minimum Requirements

Associate's or Bachelor's degree or (3) years of experience in a prospect research position. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and database management experience; familiarity with Raiser’s Edge preferred. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

Desenvolvimento de soluções automatizadas para otimizar a gestão de dados

  • Aplicar técnicas de mineração de dados e análise exploratória para entender a estrutura dos dados, detectar anomalias e identificar padrões.
  • Criar relatórios e visualizações consistentes para a equipe GSR e outras partes interessadas usando Power BI, Tableau e dashboards personalizados.

Ponto focal para Inovação e Ciência de Dados para equipes de Gestão de Ativos

  • Acompanhar o programa de inovação da afiliada e o desenvolvimento de projetos OBO conforme as necessidades dos ativos.
  • Responsável por projetar, implementar e manter a arquitetura Lakehouse de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e desempenho alinhados às necessidades dos ativos.
  • Manter a arquitetura tecnológica de dados de produção OBO no Lakehouse, validando regras, gerenciando exceções manualmente e garantindo controle de qualidade.
  • Desenvolver ferramentas para a equipe de Suporte Técnico OBO.
  • Identificar requisitos para projetos de inovação, recomendar soluções digitais e implementar metodologias avançadas para melhorar a análise e interpretação de dados.
  • Manter-se atualizado com os avanços em ciência de dados.
  • Criar ferramentas para automatizar coleta de dados, melhorar o controle de qualidade e desenvolver dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Suporte ao Monitoramento e Gestão de Reservatórios

  • Realizar o controle de qualidade dos dados, formatação e carregamento na base dados PI dos ativos não operados. Atuar proativamente na identificação e resolução de quaisquer problemas que possam surgir.
  • Suporte ao monitoramento de reservatórios por meio da automação dos fluxos de carregamento de dados e da melhoria dos painéis de produção (T-MORE/Power BI).

Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando Eletricista de Transmissão Sênior para atuar em nosso time de Manutenção.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e inspeções em linhas de transmissão, conforme procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e programação definida;
  • Atuar como referência técnica da equipe em campo, orientando eletricistas de menor senioridade (pleno e júnior) na execução das atividades, reforçando padrões de segurança, qualidade e rastreabilidade, sem caracterizar gestão administrativa de pessoal;
  • Conduzir frentes de serviço de maior criticidade em linhas, assumindo a frente em intervenções mais sensíveis (ex.: contingências, recomposições, correções relevantes e atividades com maior risco operacional), conforme procedimentos e autorizações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas e verificações de campo, apoiando o diagnóstico de anomalias recorrentes e a definição de encaminhamentos padronizados para correção, alinhando com o Encarregado e/ou Supervisor quando necessário;
  • Preparar e organizar a frente de trabalho, incluindo recursos, materiais, ferramentas/equipamentos, EPI/EPC, sinalização e isolamento, assegurando recomposição e limpeza do local após a execução;
  • Executar atividades em altura quando requerido, conforme procedimentos e requisitos de segurança aplicáveis;
  • Executar medições e verificações de campo aplicáveis às rotinas de manutenção/inspeção em linhas, registrando resultados e evidências conforme procedimentos;
  • Apoiar rotinas de inspeção de faixa de servidão e tratamento de anomalias associadas, incluindo suporte às atividades de manejo de vegetação (roçada, poda e corte/supressão quando aplicável), conforme requisitos ambientais e padrões internos;
  • Apoiar o atendimento a estações de telecom e infraestrutura associada, incluindo conservação, organização e manutenção básica de sistemas de serviços auxiliares, sob orientação do Técnico de Manutenção responsável por telecom e conforme procedimentos aplicáveis;
  • Acompanhar e orientar a execução de serviços por terceiros quando designado, verificando conformidade com requisitos de segurança, instruções de trabalho, escopo e evidências para aceite técnico;
  • Permanecer de sobreaviso quando escalado e atuar no atendimento de ocorrências e manobras associadas às intervenções em linhas, sob coordenação do Centro de Operação e conforme procedimentos vigentes;
  • Registrar checklists, fotos, relatórios e apontamentos técnicos no EQM-InformaSistema informatizado da manutenção, assegurando rastreabilidade e qualidade do histórico;
  • Reportar anomalias, restrições, riscos e necessidades de recursos ao Encarregado e/ou Supervisor, contribuindo para priorização e tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar a conservação e a manutenção básica das instalações e infraestrutura de apoio (predial/civil leve), conforme diretrizes locais;
  • Cumprir rigorosamente normas, procedimentos e requisitos de segurança (incluindo NR-10/SEP, NR-35 e regras locais), interrompendo atividades e comunicando a liderança diante de condição insegura;
  • Conduzir veículos da empresa, zelando pela utilização correta, conservação e segurança, bem como pelo adequado uso e preservação de EPI’s, EPC’s, ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Formação profissional/qualificação na área elétrica (ex.: Eletricista de Manutenção, Eletricista de Linhas ou equivalente);
  • Vivência em manutenção/inspeção de linhas de transmissão (preferencialmente em ativos do Sistema Interligado Nacional);
  • Aptidão para atividades em campo, incluindo condições para atuação em trabalho em altura quando requerido;
  • CNH categoria B.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Noções de leitura e interpretação de desenhos/arranjos e procedimentos de campo aplicáveis a linhas de transmissão;
  • Vivência em rotinas de atendimento a ocorrências e recomposição associadas a intervenções em linha (conforme procedimentos operacionais);

title: Administration and Office Coordinator, Innovation Norway Americas
description:
Innovation Norway is the Trade Promotion Organization of Norway in international markets. In the Americas region we have offices in Brazil, Canada and USA. We work with a wide range of industry sectors including energy, maritime, health, and tech.

Our Rio de Janeiro office consists of three local industry advisors in addition to the Office Director and a special envoy on research and academic cooperation. All offices also host student interns.

We are now looking for an Administration and Office Coordinator for our Americas offices, to be located at our Rio de Janeiro Office. The purpose is to ensure compliant, efficient local operations by executing administrative processes, office administration, IT coordination and finance control support in line with corporate practice and local requirements, across five office locations in the Americas (Canada, USA, Brazil).

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate job postings and assist Department Manager in organizing interviews and screening of candidates, ensure compliance with local labor rules.
  • Assist in tasks and administration related to on- and offboarding
  • Follow up on pension/insurance/phone and basic time/leave/sick leave administration as per local regulations.
  • Assist in employee processes, e.g. coordinate check ins, mandatory courses and survey follow ups.
  • Light finance and controller support, i.e. documentation and quality control

You will be the go-to-person for administrative tasks related to everything from recruitment to IT equipment. It is therefore essential that you are used to coordinating many different tasks at the same time, and that having an overall view is natural to you. A high service-oriented approach will be fundamental.

Office Administration:

  • Day to day office operations
  • HSE: make sure required annual drills, checks, and any first aid & fire response kit are within local procedures, in coordination with local offices.
  • Responsible for IT equipment and preparing system accesses as pre onboarding
  • Serve as a professional contact point for embassy, consulate, landlord, vendors and/or partners on practical matters and protocol as needed.

You will be the one whom colleagues go to to get updated status and information about local law, policies and internal procedures. It is therefore important that you pay attention to details, are thorough and precise and always make sure that you stay up to date on necessary information.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of operational office management experience in an international setting, e.g. office administration, PA roles or alike.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Limpeza dinâmico e proativo para liderar nossas equipes operacionais. Nesta função, você será o elo fundamental entre a estratégia da empresa e a execução impecável no cliente. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Supervisionar e orientar as equipes de limpeza e conservação em diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos cronogramas de trabalho e os padrões de qualidade GSS.
  • Realizar a gestão de insumos, controlando a utilização de materiais e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e desenvolver os colaboradores, focando em técnicas eficientes e segurança do trabalho.
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e manter o contato direto com os clientes para garantir a satisfação total com os serviços prestados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários para otimizar a performance da equipe.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha “Segurança Sem Preconceito” , reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar, escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).
  • Segurança do Trabalho: Fiscalizar o uso obrigatório de EPIs e garantir que todas as normas de segurança (NRs) sejam respeitadas no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em produtos químicos (diluição, PH, superfícies) e operação de máquinas de limpeza industrial.
  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).
  • Possuir CNH ativa (categoria B ou superior) e disponibilidade para deslocamento entre diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de Segurança Patrimonial ou Terceirização de Serviços de Grande Porte.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).
  • Residir na região ou ter fácil acesso aos principais eixos de atendimento da empresa.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha “Segurança Sem Preconceito” , reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar, escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).

  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.

  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).

  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de Segurança Patrimonial ou Terceirização de Serviços de Grande Porte.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).

Hiring: Two Faculty Positions (open rank) for Fall 2026

Position Title: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work

Appointment Type: Full-Time, Tenure-Track

Department: Social Work

Reports To: Dean, School of Social Work

The Howard University School of Social Work (HUSSW) invites applications for two open-rank faculty positions: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor. Founded in 1867, and located in Washington, DC, in our nation’s capital, Howard University is a historically Black College/University and Research 1 (R1) institution with a distinguished legacy of advancing knowledge, leadership, and service in pursuit of social justice and equity. Serving 400 students, the Howard University School of Social Work offers two MSW concentrations: Direct Practice and Community, Administration, and Policy Practice. These concentrations are delivered through two program platforms, on-campus (Flagship) and online (Starship). The School offers specializations in criminal justice, health, mental health, family and child welfare, displaced populations, and social gerontology. We also offer three dual degree programs: MSW/MPH, MSW/MDiv, and MSW/MBA. Additionally, the School offers a Ph.D. in Social Work with specialized areas of scholarly inquiry.

Grounded in the University’s enduring motto, Truth and Service, the HUSSW prepares scholars and practitioners committed to improving human well-being and addressing the structural conditions that affect marginalized communities. The School’s guiding philosophy, Black Perspective, further shapes its intellectual and practice framework through our curriculum and faculty scholarship that examine social and economic injustice, social determinants of health, behavioral health, poverty, and disparities effecting quality of life, particularly for African Americans and other historically oppressed populations. Our School has been continuously accredited during its 90-year history. We are a highly ranked graduate/professional program at the university having been ranked by the U.S. News and World Report among the country’s top-20 MSW programs.

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Teaching and Instruction

  • Teach graduate social work courses to include use of appropriate technologies
  • Use inclusive, student-centered instructional strategies
  • Participate in curriculum development and assessment
  • Mentor MSW and PhD students

Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda
  • Produce peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations
  • Pursue funding opportunities to support research and scholarship

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment
  • MSW from a CSWE-accredited program
  • Demonstrated ability or potential for effective teaching, research, and scholarship that aligns with the school’s needs, mission, vision, and guiding philosophy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online
  • At least two years post-MSW practice experience and social work licensure
  • Applicants for associate and full professor ranks must have a record of funded research

The University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching, research and service, committed to the development of distinguished, historically aware, and compassionate graduates and to the discovery of solutions to human problems in the United States and throughout the world. With an abiding interest in both domestic and international affairs, the University is committed to continuing to produce leaders for America and the global community.

To Apply

For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vitae and two samples of scholarly work. Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $80,000 - $110,000

title: Research Manager
description:
Job Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Research Manager is responsible for executing the research program envisioned by the Founding Director, in consultation with the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research. This individual acts as a project manager for all HIAS research activity, ensuring high quality and fulfilment of deadlines. They conduct primary and secondary research, conduct fact-checks, supervise a team of Research Assistants, and handle all research-related communication with internal and external partners. The ideal candidate will share a commitment to HIAS’s mission and possess a passion for translating academic research for public audiences across a variety of media (books, articles, television, social media, film, podcasts). They will have a pulse on research developments that promise to engage public-facing audiences. The Research Manager reports directly to the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research.

Supervisory Authority

This role supervises a team of two to three full-time research assistants, and two to three part-time student research assistants.

Nature And Scope

This position interacts with faculty, staff, students, and internal and external contacts.

Research – Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct research (history and other social science fields, as needed) in primary and secondary sources
  • Fact-check and copy-edit research products prior to publication
  • Synthesize academic research findings for public audiences
  • Stay abreast of current events and research trends, and communicate analyses that might serve public-facing audiences to the Director, Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research, The Emancipator editors, staff and journalists, and others
  • Identify experts and archives of interest for research projects
  • Develop research standards and protocols in collaboration with the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research
  • Oversee team-wide compliance with proper research protocols and citations according to the Chicago Manual of Style

Management

  • Ensure project and team alignment with the Director’s vision
  • Provide daily supervision to Research Assistants, including assigning research tasks, fielding and answering research-related questions, identifying and addressing inefficiencies, problem-solving, and ensuring deadlines are met
  • Guide the professional development of Research Assistants, identifying strengths, areas for growth, and working with the Director and the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research to identify opportunities to assist in that growth
  • Build a team of self-starters who also excel in collaborative work

Collaboration And Communication

  • Work closely with the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research to manage the workflow of Research Assistants
  • Correspond and coordinate with internal (HIAS staff and fellows, Emancipator editors and journalists, Howard University staff and administrators) and external (scholars, publishers, producers, production companies) partners to ensure quality and timely delivery of research products

Core Competencies

Technical Proficiency:

  • Highly skilled in historical research, writing, and project management
  • Experience navigating archives and online academic databases
  • Experience creating academic citations in Chicago style
  • Competency in reading and synthesizing research outside field of expertise

Attention To Detail:

  • Meticulous in reviewing content for factual and copy-editing errors
  • Proven and constant commitment to ensuring accuracy
  • Expertise in identifying reputable and reliable sourcing

Organizational Skills:

  • Effectively manage own and direct reports’ time to meet project deadlines
  • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities based on project needs
  • Co-create research standards and protocols with Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research to train existing and new hires in practices that will facilitate high-quality and timely research products
  • Organize research-related documents (research documents, research reports, digital archives) in a neat, logical, and easily accessible way for internal use and sharing with relevant partners

Analytical Thinking:

  • Identify inefficiencies in the overall research process and discuss them with relevant stakeholders
  • Stay attuned to the historical throughlines in current events
  • Conceive of and communicate compelling research topics and approaches with internal and external partners

Communication Skills:

  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication
  • Model and cultivate a compassion-informed communication style when providing feedback that both prioritizes project execution and values individual strengths and needs

Collaborative Skills:

  • Work effectively and efficiently without constant supervision as a researcher and project manager, and collaboratively as a team player with all internal and external partners

Adaptability:

  • Flexibility to shift individual and team priorities on short notice
  • Remain committed to personal and professional growth

Project Management:

  • Develop research plans and oversee projects in each phase, from inception to completion
  • Keep team on task and on schedule

Minimum Requirements

  • Based in the Washington D.C. metro area.
  • Education: Ph.D. in History, African American Studies, or a related field
  • Historical research background in racist policies and/or practices
  • Knowledge of proper research methods and proper citation practices (Chicago Manual of Style)
  • Experience locating historical documents, secondary research, and navigating relevant archives and databases
  • Demonstrated proficiency in project management and leadership
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Rate: $75,000 to $85,000

No entanto, igualmente importante – você tem uma mentalidade de crescimento; está motivado a impulsionar seu próprio desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. title: Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior - Rio de Janeiro e Costa Verde
description:
Resumo

Esta é uma oportunidade única para ingressar em um dos motores comerciais mais dinâmicos do setor de travel tech na América Latina. Como Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior , você terá ownership real sobre uma carteira de hotéis e receptivos na região do Rio de Janeiro e Costa Verde (Paraty, Angra dos Reis, Trindade), atuando em uma das verticais de maior crescimento na Decolar. O papel exige um perfil consultivo e estratégico, com foco em rentabilização e gestão de carteira. Você será o trusted advisor dos hotéis sob sua responsabilidade, construindo relações de confiança e posicionando a Decolar como parte essencial da estratégia de crescimento dos parceiros.

Para se candidatar, é essencial demonstrar experiência relevante em travel ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo, bem como formação adequada e habilidades de análise de dados e relacionamento com parceiros.

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  • Construção de Relacionamento: Desenvolver relações de confiança com os hotéis e receptivos da sua carteira, entendendo profundamente seus negócios, desafios e objetivos.
  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Monitorar e otimizar disponibilidade, competitividade tarifária, conversão e saúde do relacionamento com os parceiros, independentemente do porte do hotel.
  • Negociação Comercial: Conduzir negociações contínuas de tarifas, inventário, promoções e mídia paga nas marcas Decolar, HotelDo, entre outras.
  • Análise de Dados e Diagnóstico: Utilizar ferramentas como Metabase, Power BI e Excel para identificar padrões, priorizar oportunidades e criar planos de ação baseados em dados.
  • Revisões de Performance: Realizar business reviews e visitas presenciais regulares com os parceiros, aterrissando em planos de ação concretos e prazos claros.
  • Recomendações Consultivas: Traduzir dados e insights de mercado em recomendações acionáveis para os hotéis, garantindo que os parceiros saibam o que fazer, quando e por quê.
  • Gestão de Pipeline: Trabalhar a carteira com disciplina de CRM (Hubspot), mantendo oportunidades mapeadas, status atualizado e follow-ups no prazo.
  • Representação no Trade Local: Participar de visitas, feiras regionais e eventos do setor, representando a Decolar e identificando novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Interface com Parceiros: Traduzir atualizações de produto, pricing e distribuição em ganhos concretos para os hotéis.

Para se candidatar, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência: 3 a 5 anos em travel (hotelaria, operadoras, receptivos, OTAs) ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Turismo, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Consultivo: Escuta ativa, postura estratégica e capacidade de ganhar confiança pela substância das recomendações.
  • Habilidade com Dados: Excel avançado, leitura fluente de dashboards (Metabase, Power BI) e curiosidade para entender os números em profundidade.
  • Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir conversas comerciais do zero.
  • Perfil de Owner: Proatividade, iniciativa e capacidade de fechar ciclos de trabalho sem necessidade de instruções constantes.
  • Ferramentas: Experiência com CRM (Hubspot), Google Workspace e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes na região do RJ e Costa Verde. É importante que tenha CNH ativa
  • Idiomas: Português nativo; inglês intermediário; espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Paixão por Travel: Interesse genuíno pelo setor de hospitalidade online e turismo.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado local (RJ e Costa Verde).

Local de Trabalho

Base no Rio de Janeiro, com visitas frequentes aos parceiros na região.

Se você é apaixonado por travel tech, tem perfil consultivo e busca um desafio estratégico em um ambiente dinâmico, essa é a sua oportunidade!

title: Event Controller
description:
Event Controller

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich and the Senior Event Controller, the Event Controller will support in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implementation Phase
    • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands‑on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
    • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Planning & Operational Phase
    • Support in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
    • Work closely with the FIFA27 Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
    • Assist the presentation of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
    • Support the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 accounting teams and the various budget owners.
    • Assist the review of monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required.
    • Support the preparation monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
    • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • Experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi‑entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well‑developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Have a proactive hands‑on approach to problem solving – a ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI Word & PowerPoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.
  • Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.
  • Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.
  • Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.
  • Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.
  • Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.
  • Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
  • Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.
  • Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.
  • AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.
  • Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.
  • Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus

  • Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.
  • Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).
  • Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.
  • Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.

Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances.
  • Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1.
  • Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions.
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities.
  • An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. title: Freelance Agent Evaluation Engineer
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project‑based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project‑based, not permanent employment.

What This Opportunity Involves

  • Build virtual companies following a high‑level plan - codebase, infrastructure, and context (conversations, documentation, tickets) that form a realistic environment with development history
  • Assemble and calibrate tasks from intermediate states of the virtual company: craft the prompt, define evaluation criteria, and ensure the task is solvable and the evaluation is fair
  • Design tasks set in isolated environments - emulations of a developer's workstation: a Linux machine with development tools (terminal, CLI), MCP servers (repository, task tracker, messenger, documentation, etc.), and a real web application codebase
  • Write tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones - neither too strict (breaking on valid approaches) nor too lenient (passing bad ones)
  • Iterate with an AI agent on tests - verifying they catch real problems, don't miss bad solutions, and don't break on good ones
  • Review code written by agents, analyze why an agent failed or succeeded, and design edge cases and adversarial scenarios
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers who score your work on quality criteria

What This Is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

A significant part of the work is done together with AI - it's very hard to create tasks that challenge frontier models without using frontier models.

What We Look For

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields
  • 5+ years in software development, primarily Python (FastAPI, pytest, async/await, subprocess, file operations)
  • Background in full‑stack development, with experience building React‑based interfaces (JavaScript/TypeScript) and robust back‑end systems
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration — not just running them)
  • Docker containers, and familiarity with infrastructure tools (Postgres, Kafka, Redis)
  • CI/CD understanding (GitHub Actions as a user: triggers, labels, reading results)
  • English proficiency - B2

You don't need to be an expert in every item, but you should be comfortable reading and reasoning about code across the stack.

Why this is hard

  • Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non‑trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution
  • Tasks have many valid solutions. Writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds

How It Works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $17 per hour equivalent , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission

The Data Scientist will develop and deploy data science solutions that address real‑world geoscientific, reservoir engineering, and production analysis challenges. You'll work at the intersection of domain expertise and advanced analytics, collaborating closely with geologists, geophysicists, petrophysicists, and petroleum engineers to translate complex subsurface problems into robust, actionable models and workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy data science solutions to support geoscientific, reservoir engineering, and production analysis challenges.
  • Design and maintain predictive models, exploratory analysis dashboards, and interactive workflows using SLB tools.
  • Collaborate closely with geologists, geophysicists, petrophysicists, and reservoir/production engineers to translate domain problems into robust data science solutions.
  • Deliver training sessions and technical workshops, both internally and for clients, focused on data science tools and upstream workflows.
  • Provide technical support and expertise on SLB platforms and software integrations.
  • Assist with data quality, data preparation, and data governance efforts, ensuring compliance with industry standards.
  • Support business development and pre‑sales activities, contributing to solution design and technical proposals.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Geophysics, Geology, or related Geoscience/Engineering fields.
  • Strong foundation in Statistics and Mathematics.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, preferably supporting data‑driven workflows or digital transformation projects.
  • Solid experience with Python.
  • Practical knowledge of key libraries and frameworks: Pandas, NumPy (data handling), Scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch (machine learning), and Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, or Dash (visualization).
  • Experience with time series forecasting for production and performance data.
  • Proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical thinking, clear communication skills, and ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Advanced English, Fluent Portuguese.
  • Proof of residence in Brazil.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with NLP, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Transformers, or Generative AI.
  • Familiarity with Petrel, Techlog, Pipesim, Olga or similar SLB E&P domain tools.
  • Knowledge of industry data standards such as OSDU, PPDM, and Energistics.

Descrição da vaga

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos na busca de soluções.

Para atingir a missão de ajudar a jornada das pessoas empreendedoras, nosso time tem o compromisso de resolver as demandas dos clientes, garantindo uma solução eficaz e atendimento de excelência.

Para nós, o cliente é a razão do nosso negócio e por isso temos um compromisso de extrema importância: proporcionar um atendimento acolhedor, rápido e resolutivo a fim de garantir que nossos usuários tenham mais tempo para focar em seus negócios.

Você será responsável por um atendimento de pós-venda, independentemente do produto Stone, através de um dos nossos 4 canais de comunicação (e‑mail, chat, whatsapp ou telefone) e por CRM.

Durante sua jornada, você será avaliado por metas de qualidade e eficiência, permitindo metrificar o atendimento em prol da melhoria contínua para os nossos clientes. O objetivo não é simplesmente sanar problemas, mas também encantar os empreendedores brasileiros.

O que esperamos de você

  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo;

  • Ser didático e focado no cliente;

title: Market Launch Manager - Terapia
description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands‑on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long‑term success.

Job Description

Own the launch and early scaling of Terapia in Brazil, leading operations, GTM execution, and market growth.

Terapia is a completely new digital product line, separate from our marketplace, designed to connect patients with therapists for ongoing mental health care. Patients are instantly matched with the right psychologist through a survey, which filters for preferences and therapy style, helping ensure the best possible fit.

On the therapist side, Terapia is a fresh opportunity, we onboard new therapists and create a fair, performance‑driven system.

Launched in Poland in December and now expanding to Brazil and beyond, this role is all about owning, nurturing, and successfully launching Terapia in a new market. Your work in the first 90 days will determine whether we scale, pivot, or adjust our investment. This is a hands‑on, high‑impact opportunity to shape the future of the product.

What You’ll Do

  • Understand your users deeply: Talk to patients (including unhappy ones) and therapists to uncover blockers, pain points, and opportunities to improve the experience.
  • Drive product and operational decisions: Use Pareto/MVP thinking to prioritize what to build, test, or skip, turning messy inputs into clear actions.
  • Launch and scale the market: Onboard and manage the first cohort of therapists, setting up processes to ensure smooth operations and high‑quality patient care.
  • Design and scale GTM processes , creating repeatable playbooks, and growing operations from a handful of users or hires to hundreds.
  • Adapt and improve continuously: Use feedback from users and local teams to optimize operations, product features, and the patient‑therapist matching system.
  • Thrive in ambiguity: Navigate challenges, course‑correct when needed, and learn fast in a dynamic early‑stage environment.

Your Goals in the First 90 Days

  • Make Terapia operational and ready to scale: Establish processes, systems, and workflows—including hiring the first customer success team.
  • Build your first cohort of therapists: Recruit at least 10 therapists who are ready and available to see patients.
  • Gain deep user insights: Interview 20 patients to identify the most pressing problems worth solving.
  • Optimize patient‑therapist matching: Refine the survey and matching system to ensure patients are paired with the most relevant therapists.
  • Close the feedback loop: Gather and share insights with local Docplanner teams to improve both operations and the product.

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who thrives in early‑stage, action‑oriented environments and can turn messy challenges into clear outcomes. You will own Terapia in a new market, driving operations, onboarding therapists, and shaping the product for local users.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven ability to own outcomes end‑to‑end: in a small team or early‑stage environment, thriving where things aren’t yet defined.
  • Experience launching a product, market, or operation from zero to first real users: you’ve been there, done that, and learned fast.
  • User empathy: you regularly talk to customers, therapists, or end‑users, and make decisions based on real insights.
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and confidently owning the results.
  • Demonstrated success in designing and scaling go‑to‑market processes .
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills: you can align multiple teams, influence decisions, and keep everyone informed in fast‑moving environments.
  • Analytical mindset: you can gather data, interpret insights, and translate them into clear actions.
  • Hands‑on problem solver .
  • English and Portuguese fluent .

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1. Intro Chat: A first call with our Talent Partner Ainhoa to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2. SHL numerical assessment: A 20‑minute SHL numerical reasoning test to assess your numerical acumen, given the analytical nature of the role.

3. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience, with Michal (your potential manager).

4. Business Case: A take‑home exercise with dedicated prep time, designed to understand how you approach real‑life problems and think through regulatory scenarios. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and another team member.

5. References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

Global Benefits

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

Local Perks

Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

A Truly Global Team

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility That Works for You

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

Focus on results: we're here to make an impact.

Think like an owner: take responsibility, drive outcomes.

Keep it simple, keep it lean: smart solutions over complexity.

Be respectful and radically honest: openness builds trust.

Learn and be curious: growth is part of the job.

Check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Especialista de Operações (Supply Chain) - Época Cosméticos
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma das primeiras lojas de beleza online do país, com mais de 11 anos de mercado. Em 2013, passamos a fazer parte do Grupo Magalu e, hoje, somos o e-commerce com o mix de produtos mais completo da internet. Vendemos as maiores marcas nacionais e internacionais de perfumes, maquiagens, cosméticos e muito mais. A empresa fica na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, porém a alocação pode acontecer na cidade de São Paulo.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning): Conduzir e aprimorar os ciclos de S&OP, alinhando as previsões de vendas (Demand Planning) com a execução operacional, mitigando riscos e identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Foco no Cliente (Nível de Serviço): Monitorar indicadores de performance de entrega (como OTIF - On Time In Full), garantindo a excelência na experiência do consumidor final, seja no e-commerce ou no abastecimento de lojas físicas.
  • Gestão de Fretes (Prazos e Custos): Analisar e otimizar a malha logística. Equilibrar a equação de Transit Time (prazo) x Custo de Frete, apoiando negociações com transportadoras e buscando rotas mais eficientes.
  • Controle e Estratégia de Estoque: Definir políticas de estoque de segurança, monitorar o giro de produtos e gerenciar o risco de obsolescência/vencimento (shelf-life).
  • Prevenir rupturas (stockout) e excessos (overstock).
  • Planejamento de Capacidade: Analisar a capacidade de armazenagem (CDs), picking/packing (separação e embalagem) e escoamento (expedição), dimensionando a operação para suportar picos de demanda e campanhas promocionais.

Precisamos Que Você Já Tenha

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Logística, etc.), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência Comprovada: Sólida vivência na área de Supply Chain/Operações, com visão End-to-End, preferencialmente no setor de Varejo, Bens de Consumo ou Cosméticos.
  • Processos de S&OP.
  • Gestão e matemática de Estoques.
  • Composição de custos de frete e roteirização.
  • Domínio avançado de Excel.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERPs de grande porte (SAP, Oracle, etc.) e sistemas WMS/TMS.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos

  • VR/VA, Vale Transporte, Assistência Médica e Odontológica e Auxílio Creche.
  • Wellhub para bem-estar e saúde.
  • Bolsa de estudo com até 50% de desconto.
  • Descontos especiais nas empresas do Grupo Magalu (Magalu, Netshoes, Época Cosméticos, Estante Virtual, Kabum entre outras).

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos o modelo híbrido de trabalho, que une a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto à interação presencial no escritório, oferecendo um equilíbrio entre as diferentes formas de colaboração e bem-estar.

Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, Vem ser feliz !

Nossos valores nos unem e nossas diferenças nos potencializam como um grupo. Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, clero ou deficiência.

description:
Base.com is an All-In-One Multi Channel Management System trusted by over 30k companies globally. Base.com offers proprietary SaaS solutions for merchants that helps them scale up, automate and optimize their businesses across all the sales channels. On top of best-in-class own modules for Order Management, Product Warehousing, Managing Marketplace Listings and Automating Workflows, we offer over 2000 integrations including: Amazon, MercadoLivre, Shopee, Magalu, BelezaNaWeb, Temu, TikTok, Shopify, VTEX, Magento, Correiros, Odoo, Bling, Olist, Omie, Sankya, TOTVS, SAP and many more.

Product Owner (Brazil)

We are looking for go-getters with entrepreneurial spirit to help us drive our Brazilian expansion. As a Product Owner at Base.com, you will be at the forefront of empowering our Brazilian clients to transform their e-commerce businesses into fully automated, multi-channel operations. You will be responsible for shaping and executing our Brazilian product roadmap, incl. Integrations with major online marketplaces/ecommerce platforms and 3PLs. This is a very hands‑on role, where you will also have the opportunity to participate in and, eventually, lead the most complex client engagements with our enterprise clients in Brazil.

Responsibilities

  • Prioritize and deliver high-impact integrations (e.g., online marketplaces, online stores, 3PLs, etc.)
  • Lead discovery with Brazilian merchants (SMB → enterprise) to map workflows across marketplaces, webstores, ERPs, 3PLs, accounting, and shipping; translate insights into clear PRDs and specs
  • Work with partners technical documentations API/webhooks flows and define a clear guideline for Tech Team to develop changes inside Base platform
  • Lead implementation for complex enterprise rollouts—solution design, configuration, edge-case handling, etc.
  • Create product collateral with GTM (release notes, enablement decks, partner one-pagers) and support sales cycles as product expert
  • Monitor the Brazilian competitive landscape and partner ecosystems; feed insights into build/buy/partner decisions

Requirements

  • 2+ years as Product Owner in ecommerce SaaS Business
  • Technical fluency (reading API docs, writing sample payloads, running Postman/cURL; bonus: light scripting/SQL)
  • Proven track record delivering API-driven integrations at scale (REST, OAuth, webhooks, pagination, rate-limit strategies, retries)
  • Strong discovery and systems thinking: process mapping, edge-case analysis (returns, partials, bundles, kits, backorders, cancellations)
  • Hands‑on with data and metrics: define KPIs, run analyses (SQL or equivalent), instrument events, and make roadmap trade‑offs with evidence
  • Excellent PRD/spec writing; crisp communication with engineers, enterprise clients, and executives
  • Experience leading complex client engagements and partnering with/working as Technical Implementation Expert
  • Comfort operating in a fast‑moving startup environment; bias for action and ownership

Bonus Qualifications

  • Deep marketplace expertise (Amazon, MercadoLive, Shopee, TikTok Shop etc.) or commerce platforms (Shopify, VTEX, Wake, Magento, Nuvemshop etc.)
  • ERP/WMS/Accounting integrations (TOTVS, Linx, Senior, Bling, Olist etc.)
  • 3PL/fulfillment experience (Correiros, J&T Express etc.)
  • Catalog & taxonomy normalization, variant/attribute modeling, and multi-warehouse inventory/ATP logic
  • Experience with order orchestration, routing rules, SLAs, and exception handling at enterprise scale
  • Success in high-growth SaaS or at a commerce enablement company; prior founder/owner mentality
